title: Content Fields Indexing: Query Fields With SQL | Orchard Core
description:
The values of content fields are stored inside each content item, not in database columns of their own.

The Content Fields Indexing (SQL) features copy field values into database tables, one for each indexed field type, so you can query them with SQL, with code, and in GraphQL.

In this video:
• Why field values need an index
• Enabling Content Fields Indexing (SQL) and its User Picker feature
• The tables: shared columns, value columns, rows for each value, and versions
• Running a SQL query on a field table
• Querying the tables with ISession, Razor and Liquid
• Filtering content items in GraphQL
